name: TinyMMv.5-Selkies
description: Unofficial tinyMediaManager v5 Docker image with a LinuxServer Selkies browser-based desktop interface. Provides a modern HTTPS WebUI as an alternative to the official noVNC container, persistent appdata storage, editable media mappings, and optional HTTP API access for automation.

paths.name: Selkies Config
paths.description: Persistent Selkies configuration, certificate files, and browser-desktop settings.

paths.name: tinyMediaManager Appdata
paths.description: Persistent tinyMediaManager database, settings, cache, logs, backups, and license file.

paths.name: tinyMediaManager Linux Data Path
paths.description: Must point to the same host folder as tinyMediaManager Appdata. This intentionally exposes the same files at TMM's Linux storage path without duplicating data.

paths.name: Movies
paths.description: Host folder containing your movie library.

paths.name: TV Shows
paths.description: Host folder containing your television library.

ports.name: Selkies HTTPS WebUI
ports.description: HTTPS port for the Selkies browser desktop. A self-signed certificate warning is expected on first access.

ports.name: tinyMediaManager HTTP API
ports.description: Optional tinyMediaManager HTTP API port for automation scripts.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID used to run the container. The standard unRAID nobody user is 99.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID used to run the container. The standard unRAID users group is 100.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone. Change this to your local IANA timezone if desired.

variables.name: Browser Tab Title
variables.description: Title displayed in the browser tab.

variables.name: Selkies Sidebar Title
variables.description: Title displayed in the Selkies sidebar.

variables.name: Use CSS Scaling
variables.description: Leave disabled for a sharper desktop image. High-density displays can be tuned from the Selkies sidebar.

variables.name: Interface DPI
variables.description: Desktop interface DPI. The general default is 96. Lower or raise this value if the interface is too large or too small.

variables.name: Selkies Username
variables.description: Optional username for the Selkies WebUI. Leave blank for no username.

variables.name: Selkies Password
variables.description: Optional password for the Selkies WebUI. Leave blank for no password.
